clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, dwarven priests come of age through training in healing and survival. High Priest Rohan sends acolytes through the Deeprun Tram to Stormwind, where High Priestess Laurena guides their passage into deeper mysteries.

In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, High Priest Rohan guides dwarven initiates devoted to the Holy Light. When an acolyte shows discipline and faith, Rohan sends them southwest to Stormwind. Human and dwarven clerics share close spiritual ties, and advanced teaching is centered in Stormwind City's grand halls.

The Deeprun Tram carries acolytes to Stormwind, where they climb to Cathedral Square. Inside the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena tests candidates on behalf of the Church. She teaches the desperate prayers a priest calls upon in battle: appeals for divine intervention when strength fails and death draws near.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You're needed in Stormwind, friend. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm glad you've arrived, friend. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.
